breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification perpetuates the incorrect assumption from the incomplete prompt. It reports a uniform bending stress of –11.1 MPa at all points (neutral axis, top fiber, and bottom fiber), rather than applying the correct flexure formula σ = –My/I, which gives a linear distribution: 0 MPa at the neutral axis (y=0), –33.3 MPa at the top fiber (y=+60 mm), and +33.3 MPa at the bottom fiber (y=–60 mm). The Agent did not fix the inconsistency and instead repeated the erroneous uniform-stress instruction.
